import os
import requests


def submit_transcription(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    response = requests.post(
        f"https://{config['region']}.api.cognitive.microsoft.com/speechtotext/transcriptions:submit",
        params={'api-version': '2024-11-15'},
        headers={'Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key': config.get('api_key') or os.environ['AZURE_SPEECH_KEY']},
        json={'displayName': config.get('job_name', 'transcription'),
              'locale': payload['language_code'], 'contentUrls': [payload['audio_uri']]}, timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return {'job_id': response.json()['self'], 'status': 'SUBMITTED'}

import os
import requests
from.speech_client import get_speech_client


def poll_transcription(job_id, config=None):
    client = get_speech_client(config)
    response = client.get(f"https://{config['region']}.api.cognitive.microsoft.com/speechtotext/transcriptions/{job_id}", params={'api-version': '2024-11-15'})
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()['transcripts'][0]['text'] if response.json()['status'] == 'Succeeded' else None

import os
import requests
from.speech_client import get_speech_client


def diarized_transcript(job_id, config=None):
    client = get_speech_client(config)
    response = client.post(f"https://{config['region']}.api.cognitive.microsoft.com/speechtotext/transcriptions/{job_id}/diarize", params={'api-version': '2024-11-15'})
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()['transcripts'][0]['text'] if response.json()['status'] == 'Succeeded' else None

import os
import requests
from.speech_client import get_speech_client


def timestamped_transcript(job_id, config=None):
    client = get_speech_client(config)
    response = client.get(f"https://{config['region']}.api.cognitive.microsoft.com/speechtotext/transcriptions/{job_id}", params={'api-version': '2024-11-15'})
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()['transcripts'][0]['text'] if response.json()['status'] == 'Succeeded' else None

import os
import requests


def translate_transcript(text, target_language='en'):
    response = requests.post(
        'https://api.deepl.com/v2/translate',
        params={'auth_key': os.environ['DEEPL_API_KEY'], 'text': text, 'target_lang': target_language},
        timeout=30
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()['translations'][0]['text']

import os
import requests


def moderate_transcript(text):
    response = requests.post(
        'https://api.perspectiveapi.com/v1/comment',
        params={'key': os.environ['PERSPECTIVE_API_KEY'], 'text': text},
        timeout=30
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()['attributeScores']

import os
import requests


def archive_summary(text):
    response = requests.post(
        'https://api.summarize.com/v1/summarize',
        params={'api_key': os.environ['SUMMARIZE_API_KEY'], 'text': text},
        timeout=30
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()['summary']

import os
import requests


def transcript_embedding(text):
    response = requests.post(
        'https://api.embed.com/v1/embed',
        params={'api_key': os.environ['EMBED_API_KEY'], 'text': text},
        timeout=30
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()['embedding']
